title: A Theory of Usable Information Under Computational Constraints
evidence: §2 Definitions 1–3、§3.2：受限预测族下的可用信息；不保证实际训练达到族内最优。

title: Conditional probing: measuring usable information beyond a baseline
evidence: 条件 probing 定义及两探针比较：已有 baseline 会改变表示的增量价值；实验对象为 NLP 表示。

title: Approximation by Superpositions of a Sigmoidal Function
evidence: §3 Theorem 2：特定 sigmoid 网络的通用逼近；是存在性，不含工程预算保证。

title: Benefits of depth in neural networks
evidence: Theorem 1.1：构造函数的深度/规模分离；不证明所有任务都需要深度。

title: On the Spectral Bias of Neural Networks
evidence: §2–4：Fourier 结构及低频先学实验；频谱偏好依网络、坐标和数据几何。

title: Fourier Features Let Networks Learn High Frequency Functions in Low Dimensional Domains
evidence: §3–5：输入 Fourier 映射改变 NTK 频谱与学习；重点为低维坐标回归。

title: The Implicit Bias of Gradient Descent on Separable Data
evidence: Assumptions 1–3、Theorem 3：可分线性模型中的最大间隔方向；不可泛化为任意 Adam 深网。

title: Failures of Gradient-Based Deep Learning
evidence: §2–4：梯度信号、条件数等失败机制；parity 困难受分布和算法限制。

title: Learning Parities with Neural Networks
evidence: Theorems 2–3：特定混合分布、ReLU6 与总体损失更新下的正结果；非任意 parity 保证。

title: The Pitfalls of Simplicity Bias in Neural Networks
evidence: §3–5：过度依赖简单信号的构造与实验；容易学与稳定泛化不同。

title: All Models are Wrong, but Many are Useful: Learning a Variable’s Importance by Studying an Entire Class of Prediction Models Simultaneously
evidence: 模型依赖与模型类依赖定义：多个好模型可依赖不同变量；不是因果重要性。

title: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
evidence: 正则化目标与贪心分裂；主文 XOR 为基于机制的独立推导。

title: LightGBM: A Highly Efficient Gradient Boosting Decision Tree
evidence: GOSS/EFB 与计算效率；效率优化不等同于加入任意算术原语。

title: CatBoost: unbiased boosting with categorical features
evidence: ordered boosting、类别统计与组合；需区分训练统计先验与固定行内变换。

title: Factorization Machines
evidence: 二阶模型方程与参数分解；作者官网提供论文入口，低秩共享不保证任意未见组合恢复。

title: Field-aware Factorization Machines for CTR Prediction
evidence: §2–3：按对方 field 选 embedding；自由度与计算/过拟合风险一起增加。

title: Wide & Deep Learning for Recommender Systems
evidence: 显式交叉记忆与深层泛化结合；wide 特征仍需设计，不代表彻底消除工程。

title: DeepFM: A Factorization-Machine based Neural Network for CTR Prediction
evidence: FM 与 DNN 共享 embedding；低阶路径与深层路径的偏置不同。

title: Product-based Neural Networks for User Response Prediction
evidence: 产品层提供内/外积，再接深层网络；完整网络不受纯二阶模型的同一限制。

title: Deep & Cross Network for Ad Click Predictions
evidence: 原 cross 递推与显式有界阶交叉；需留意偏置位置及跨坐标共享。

title: DCN V2: Improved Deep & Cross Network and Practical Lessons for Web-scale Learning to Rank Systems
evidence: 普通 cross 矩阵化、低秩与专家扩展；L+1 次数仅适用于对应纯 cross 递推。

title: xDeepFM: Combining Explicit and Implicit Feature Interactions for Recommender Systems
evidence: CIN 与深层路径结合；向量级显式交互不是任意独立多项式系数。

title: Attention Is All You Need
evidence: §3：缩放点积、多头与位置编码；通用公式不保证表格算术外推。

title: AutoInt: Automatic Feature Interaction Learning via Self-Attentive Neural Networks
evidence: 多头自注意力的字段交互；“交互阶数”不应当作严格多项式次数。

title: TabTransformer: Tabular Data Modeling Using Contextual Embeddings
evidence: 上下文化类别 embedding；不要与 FT-Transformer 的全字段 tokenization 混同。

title: Deep Interest Network for Click-Through Rate Prediction
evidence: 候选相关局部激活；未归一化权重与标准 softmax attention 有区别。

title: TabNet: Attentive Interpretable Tabular Learning
evidence: 逐步稀疏选择与特征处理；选择权重不能直接解释为因果重要性。

title: Neural Oblivious Decision Ensembles for Deep Learning on Tabular Data
evidence: 可微 oblivious decision ensembles；硬树与软选择训练并不等价。

title: Neural Arithmetic Logic Units
evidence: 算术操作与外推实验；内置操作不消除所有优化问题。

title: Neural Arithmetic Units
evidence: NAU/NMU、初始化与稀疏约束；给数值关系提供专门计算偏置。

title: Accurate Intelligible Models with Pairwise Interactions
evidence: GAM/GA²M 与成对作用；交互取决于链接尺度，单步残差分裂可能无信号。

title: Random Features for Large-Scale Kernel Machines
evidence: 随机 Fourier 特征近似平移不变核；核带宽与随机基分布提供特定几何先验。

title: InterpretML: A Unified Framework for Machine Learning Interpretability
evidence: §3 EBM：循环逐特征 boosting、bagging 与成对项；不自动包含任意高阶交互。

title: Revisiting Deep Learning Models for Tabular Data
evidence: §4–5：11 个数据集、强 ResNet/FT-Transformer；单划分与预算限制下无统一赢家。

title: Why do tree-based models still outperform deep learning on typical tabular data?
evidence: §3、§5：45 数据集，主实验≤10K训练样本；旋转可保信息，平滑/删列不是同类干预。

title: On Embeddings for Numerical Features in Tabular Deep Learning
evidence: §3–5：PLE/周期嵌入对多个骨干有效；参数、监督分箱和调参成本需另计。

title: TabR: Tabular Deep Learning Meets Nearest Neighbors
evidence: 学习近邻检索与标签聚合；不是纯单行固定表示对照。arXiv早期标题带in 2023。

title: Better by Default: Strong Pre-Tuned MLPs and Boosted Trees on Tabular Data
evidence: RealMLP：118 meta-train、90 meta-test任务；v3披露XGBoost编码修正及部分未重跑结果。

title: TabM: Advancing Tabular Deep Learning with Parameter-Efficient Ensembling
evidence: 46 数据集、共享参数集成；旧TabPFN基线不能代表Nature 2025版本。

title: Accurate predictions on small data with a tabular foundation model
evidence: 2025-01-08发表；主要≤10K样本、≤500列；目标任务成本不含大规模合成任务预训练。

title: Revisiting Nearest Neighbor for Tabular Data: A Deep Tabular Baseline Two Decades Later
evidence: ModernNCA，300 数据集；表示、优化与推断规则共同改变，另计检索成本。
